name: REN - DEV - UTIL-04 - Pilot Observability Dashboard_quicklink

parameters.content:
## UTIL-04 - Pilot Observability Dashboard

`GET /webhook/renov/dev/ops/observability?hours=24`

HTML interno con métricas agregadas de mensajes, handoffs, errores, LLM y colas.

Los datos requieren `RENOV_INTERNAL_TOKEN` por Bearer o `X-Internal-Token`. La pantalla inicial permite ingresarlo sin ponerlo en la URL ni almacenarlo.

No devuelve PII, cuerpos, payloads ni errores crudos. Cache deshabilitada.

parameters.jsCode:
function validAlertUrl(value) {
  const text = String(value || '').trim();
  const match = text.match(/^https://([a-z0-9.-]+)(?::([0-9]{1,5}))?(/[^\s#]*)?$/i);
  if (!match) return '';
  if (match[2] && Number(match[2]) > 65535) return '';
  if (match[1].startsWith('.') || match[1].endsWith('.') || match[1].includes('..')) return '';
  return text;
}

function env(name) {
    try { return String($env[name] || '').trim(); } catch (error) { return ''; }
  }
  function readHeader(headers, name) {
    const target = name.toLowerCase();
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(headers || {})) {
      if (String(key).toLowerCase() === target) return Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value;
    }
    return '';
  }
  function safeEqual(left, right) {
    const a = String(left || '');
    const b = String(right || '');
    if (!a || a.length !== b.length) return false;
    let difference = 0;
    for (let index = 0; index < a.length; index += 1) difference |= a.charCodeAt(index) ^ b.charCodeAt(index);
    return difference === 0;
  }
  const request = $input.first().json || {};
  const expectedToken = env('RENOV_INTERNAL_TOKEN');
  if (!expectedToken) {
    return [{ json: { authorized: false, statusCode: 503, reason: 'dashboard_not_configured' } }];
  }
  const authorization = String(readHeader(request.headers, 'authorization') || '');
  const providedToken = readHeader(request.headers, 'x-internal-token')
    || (/^Bearer\s+/i.test(authorization) ? authorization.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim() : '');
  if (!safeEqual(providedToken, expectedToken)) {
    return [{ json: { authorized: false, statusCode: 401, reason: 'authentication_required' } }];
  }
  const rawHours = String(request.query?.hours ?? '24').trim();
  if (!/^[0-9]{1,3}$/.test(rawHours) || Number(rawHours) < 1 || Number(rawHours) > 168) {
    return [{ json: { authorized: false, statusCode: 422, reason: 'invalid_window' } }];
  }
  return [{ json: {
    authorized: true,
    statusCode: 200,
    window_hours: Number(rawHours),
    dashboard_sql: "WITH config AS (
  SELECT
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE($1::integer, 24), 1), 168) AS window_hours,
    now() AS generated_at
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    window_hours,
    generated_at,
    generated_at - make_interval(hours => window_hours) AS starts_at
  FROM config
), message_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'inbound')::integer AS inbound_messages,
    count(DISTINCT conversation_id) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'inbound')::integer AS responding_conversations,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'outbound' AND sender = 'bot')::integer AS bot_messages,
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE direction = 'outbound'
        AND sender = 'bot'
        AND delivery_status IN ('accepted', 'sent', 'delivered', 'read')
    )::integer AS bot_messages_accepted,
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE direction = 'outbound'
        AND sender = 'bot'
        AND delivery_status IN ('delivered', 'read')
    )::integer AS bot_messages_delivered,
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE direction = 'outbound'
        AND sender = 'bot'
        AND delivery_status = 'failed'
    )::integer AS bot_messages_failed
  FROM renovation_dev.messages, bounds
  WHERE occurred_at >= bounds.starts_at
), conversation_counts AS (
  SELECT status::text AS status, count(*)::integer AS total
  FROM renovation_dev.conversations
  GROUP BY status
), conversation_metrics AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(status, total ORDER BY status), '{}'::jsonb) AS by_status
  FROM conversation_counts
), handoff_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE event_type IN ('chatwoot_handoff', 'chatwoot_handoff_ambiguous') AND success
    )::integer AS successful_handoffs,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'chatwoot_conversation_resolved' AND success)::integer AS resolved_handoffs,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'chatwoot_human_intervention' AND success)::integer AS human_takeovers
  FROM renovation_dev.interaction_logs, bounds
  WHERE created_at >= bounds.starts_at
), failure_counts AS (
  SELECT event_type, count(*)::integer AS total
  FROM renovation_dev.interaction_logs, bounds
  WHERE created_at >= bounds.starts_at
    AND success = false
  GROUP BY event_type
), failure_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(sum(total), 0)::integer AS total,
    COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(event_type, total ORDER BY event_type), '{}'::jsonb) AS by_event
  FROM failure_counts
), llm_attempt_rows AS (
  SELECT
    attempt->>'provider' AS provider,
    NULLIF(attempt->>'failure_reason', '') AS failure_reason,
    CASE
      WHEN attempt->>'latency_ms' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (attempt->>'latency_ms')::integer
      ELSE NULL
    END AS latency_ms
  FROM renovation_dev.interaction_logs log
  CROSS JOIN bounds
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(log.payload #> '{metadata,llm_attempts}') = 'array'
        THEN log.payload #> '{metadata,llm_attempts}'
      ELSE '[]'::jsonb
    END
  ) attempt
  WHERE log.event_type = 'wf03b_chatwoot_waba_inbound'
    AND log.created_at >= bounds.starts_at
    AND attempt->>'provider' IN ('openai', 'gemini')
), llm_provider_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    provider,
    count(*)::integer AS attempts,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE failure_reason IS NOT NULL)::integer AS failures,
    round(avg(latency_ms))::integer AS average_latency_ms,
    round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms))::numeric)::integer AS p95_latency_ms
  FROM llm_attempt_rows
  GROUP BY provider
), llm_metrics AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'provider', provider,
        'attempts', attempts,
        'failures', failures,
        'average_latency_ms', average_latency_ms,
        'p95_latency_ms', p95_latency_ms
      ) ORDER BY provider
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS providers
  FROM llm_provider_metrics
), double_llm_failures AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS total
  FROM renovation_dev.interaction_logs, bounds
  WHERE event_type = 'wf03b_chatwoot_waba_inbound'
    AND created_at >= bounds.starts_at
    AND payload #>> '{metadata,llm_fallback_used}' = 'true'
    AND payload #>> '{metadata,llm_provider}' IS NULL
), campaign_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    count(*)::integer AS hsm_items,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('accepted', 'sent', 'delivered', 'read'))::integer AS hsm_accepted,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'read'))::integer AS hsm_delivered,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')::integer AS hsm_failed
  FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatch_items, bounds
  WHERE created_at >= bounds.starts_at
), dispatch_health AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'queued')::integer AS queued,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'running')::integer AS running,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')::integer AS failed,
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE status = 'queued'
        AND process_after < bounds.generated_at - interval '15 minutes'
        AND renovation_dev.is_automatic_send_allowed(bounds.generated_at)
    )::integer AS stalled,
    COALESCE(max(
      CASE WHEN status = 'queued'
        THEN GREATEST(0, extract(epoch FROM bounds.generated_at - process_after))::integer
      END
    ), 0)::integer AS oldest_queued_seconds
  FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
  CROSS JOIN bounds
  WHERE dispatch.dev_simulate_http_status IS NULL
), callback_health AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'queued')::integer AS queued,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'running')::integer AS running,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'failed')::integer AS failed,
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE state = 'queued' AND process_after < bounds.generated_at - interval '15 minutes'
    )::integer AS stalled,
    COALESCE(max(
      CASE WHEN state = 'queued'
        THEN GREATEST(0, extract(epoch FROM bounds.generated_at - process_after))::integer
      END
    ), 0)::integer AS oldest_queued_seconds
  FROM renovation_dev.salesforce_callback_events, bounds
)
SELECT
  bounds.generated_at,
  bounds.starts_at,
  bounds.window_hours,
  renovation_dev.is_automatic_send_allowed(bounds.generated_at) AS automatic_send_allowed,
  message_metrics.inbound_messages,
  message_metrics.responding_conversations,
  message_metrics.bot_messages,
  message_metrics.bot_messages_accepted,
  message_metrics.bot_messages_delivered,
  message_metrics.bot_messages_failed,
  conversation_metrics.by_status AS conversations_by_status,
  handoff_metrics.successful_handoffs,
  handoff_metrics.resolved_handoffs,
  handoff_metrics.human_takeovers,
  failure_metrics.total AS interaction_failures,
  failure_metrics.by_event AS failures_by_event,
  llm_metrics.providers AS llm_providers,
  double_llm_failures.total AS double_llm_failures,
  campaign_metrics.hsm_items,
  campaign_metrics.hsm_accepted,
  campaign_metrics.hsm_delivered,
  campaign_metrics.hsm_failed,
  dispatch_health.queued AS dispatch_queued,
  dispatch_health.running AS dispatch_running,
  dispatch_health.failed AS dispatch_failed,
  dispatch_health.stalled AS dispatch_stalled,
  dispatch_health.oldest_queued_seconds AS dispatch_oldest_queued_seconds,
  callback_health.queued AS callback_queued,
  callback_health.running AS callback_running,
  callback_health.failed AS callback_failed,
  callback_health.stalled AS callback_stalled,
  callback_health.oldest_queued_seconds AS callback_oldest_queued_seconds
FROM bounds
CROSS JOIN message_metrics
CROSS JOIN conversation_metrics
CROSS JOIN handoff_metrics
CROSS JOIN failure_metrics
CROSS JOIN llm_metrics
CROSS JOIN double_llm_failures
CROSS JOIN campaign_metrics
CROSS JOIN dispatch_health
CROSS JOIN callback_health",
    dashboard_params: [Number(rawHours)],
    alert_webhook_configured: Boolean(validAlertUrl(env('RENOV_OBSERVABILITY_ALERT_URL'))),
  } }];
